items.title: 60322_John Bubbles oral history interview
items.q: so the manager called us down from the gallery to want to know if we wanted to go on in this act's place.

ctx.x: We were only ushering in the theatre about

two weeks when an act appeared out of vaudeville, an act came and he was too sick to appear, so the manager called us down from the gallery to want to know if we wanted to go on in this act's place. I told him yes, because this manager had seen us at these parties. He knew what we could do. His name is George Carter.

However, he say, you go home and getyourself together and come on back for the next show. So okay, we did. We went on home and got dressed, got our clothes, come back for the next show but didn't know he was going to have a tutor for us. He had a tutor there for us to help us dress and put us on the stage, colored fellow, who was an entertainer, comedian, and we had to put on gloves, burnt cork -- our natural color you wouldn't see, we covered that with burnt cork, like Al Jolson, understand?
